table.retrieve:
SELECT saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,
		 manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=max(item.manfcode)),
		 date = (case :as_reportdate 
				 when 'originaldate' then max(dbo.saleledger.originaldate)  when 'billingdate' then 						max(dbo.saleledger.billingdate)
				 else dbo.saleledger.date
				 end), 
       invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
       flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
       misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
       invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,
       invgstperc1 =max( dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1),
		 CustRefNo   = dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo,
		 CustRefNo2   =max( dbo.saleledger.CustRefNo2),
		 ward			  =(select name from ward where wardcode=max(saleledger.wardcode)),
		 remarks     = dbo.saleledger.Remarks,
		 posted = Max(dbo.saleledger.posted),	
		 rowid = max(dbo.saledetail.rowid),
		 looseqty = sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty), 
		 bonusqty = sum(dbo.saledetail.bonusqty), 
		 machinename=max(saleledger.machinename),
		 grosstotal=sum(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.saleprice),
		 machineuser=(select users.username from users where users.usercode=max(saleledger.salesmancode)),
		 packing=case
						when max(dbo.item.packcode) IS Null then space(30) 
						else max(dbo.itempacking.name)
					end,
       itemflatdisc=max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
       packqty  = sum(saledetail.packqty),  
       price = dbo.saledetail.saleprice,    
       itemdiscperc = dbo.saledetail.discperc,    
		 packunits = dbo.saledetail.packunits,    
		 batch = max(dbo.saledetail.batch),    
		 expiry = min(dbo.saledetail.expiry),    
		 salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),
	 	 itemname = item.name,
		 unitsalestax = dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax ,    
		 gstperc = dbo.saledetail.gstperc ,    
		 datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, saleledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, saleledger.date)))), 
		 Person = dbo.accounts.name,
		 /* 
		 invnettotalexctax= (SELECT 
                    amountfg = Round( 
                                     Sum (  SD.looseqty *  SD.saleprice)    
			                            -  Round(Sum (Round((  SD.looseqty  * ( SD.saleprice -  SD.itemflatdisc) * ( SD.discperc * .01)) + ( SD.looseqty  *  SD.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)    
    		                            - Sum ( Round( SD.looseqty   * ( SD.saleprice  -  SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * ( SL.discperc /100)
	      									 + misccharges - flatdisc,0)
			
    			 FROM dbo.saleledger SL , 
         			dbo.saledetail SD

   			 WHERE  (SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
						  (SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )   
         
				 GROUP BY SL.misccharges,   
         				 SL.flatdisc,   
         				 SL.date,   
         				 SL.saleinvcode, 
  						    SL.invgstperc1, 
							 SL.discperc,  
		   			  	 SL.salestax 
			) , */
		 totalsalestax = (SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
										 Round (
		/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SD.looseqty * ( SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
											    * ( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
 		/*items salestax*/		 + Sum (Round ((SD.looseqty + SD.bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SD.looseqty * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
										 , 0 )
    			 FROM dbo.saleledger SL , 
         			dbo.saledetail SD

   			 WHERE  (SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
						  (SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )   
         
				 GROUP BY SL.misccharges,   
         				 SL.flatdisc,   
         				 SL.date,   
         				 SL.saleinvcode, 
  						    SL.invgstperc1, 
							 SL.discperc,  
		   			  	 SL.salestax 
			)

FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saledetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking  ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  dbo.saleledger.custcode=:ai_custcode and
		 (case :as_reportdate 
				 when 'originaldate' then dbo.saleledger.originaldate  when 'billingdate' then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
				 else dbo.saleledger.date
				 end) >=:ad_StartDate and
		 (case :as_reportdate 
				 when 'originaldate' then dbo.saleledger.originaldate  when 'billingdate' then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
				 else dbo.saleledger.date
				 end)<=:ad_enddate and
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and  
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode 
GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
				saleledger.date, 
				saleledger.custcode, 
				saleledger.discperc, 
				saleledger.flatdisc, 
				saleledger.misccharges, 
				saleledger.salestax, 
				saleledger.remarks,
				saleledger.custrefno, 
				saledetail.icode,
				saledetail.saleprice,
				saledetail.rowgroup, 
				saledetail.discperc,
				saledetail.packunits,
				saledetail.unitsalestax,
				saledetail.gstperc,
				item.name,
				item.icode,
				item.printable, 
				accounts.name
				
UNION ALL

    		                            - Sum ( Round( SD.looseqty   * ( SD.saleprice  -  SD.itemflatdisc) * (1 - ( SD.discperc * .01)),2)) * ( SL.discperc /100)
	      									 + misccharges - flatdisc,0)
			
    			 FROM dbo.saleledger SL , 
         			sd SD

   			 WHERE  (SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
						  (SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )   
         
				 GROUP BY SL.misccharges,   
         				 SL.flatdisc,   
         				 SL.date,   
         				 SL.saleinvcode, 
  						    SL.invgstperc1, 
							 SL.discperc,  
		   			  	 SL.salestax 
			) , */
		 totalsalestax = (SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
										 Round (
		/*invoice level salestax*/Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SDD.looseqty * ( SDD.saleprice - SDD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SDD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) )
											    * ( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 )
 		/*items salestax*/		 + Sum (Round ((SDD.looseqty + SDD.bonusqty) * SDD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (SDD.looseqty * (SDD.saleprice - SDD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - SDD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SDD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
										 , 0 )
    			 FROM dbo.saleledger SL , 
         			dbo.saleinvdetail SDD

   			 WHERE  (SL.saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode )   and
						  (SL.saleinvcode = SDD.saleinvcode )   
         
				 GROUP BY SL.misccharges,   
         				 SL.flatdisc,   
         				 SL.date,   
         				 SL.saleinvcode, 
  						    SL.invgstperc1, 
							 SL.discperc,  
		   			  	 SL.salestax 
			)

FROM
	dbo.saleledger, 
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking  ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts
WHERE  DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' AND
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode=:ai_custcode and
		 (case :as_reportdate 
				 when 'originaldate' then dbo.saleledger.originaldate  when 'billingdate' then dbo.saleledger.billingdate
				 else dbo.saleledger.date
				 end) >=:ad_StartDate and
		 (case :as_reportdate

				 end)<=:ad_enddate and
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and  
		 sd.icode = item.icode and 
		 dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode

				saleledger.custcode, 
				saleledger.discperc, 
				saleledger.flatdisc, 
				saleledger.misccharges, 
				saleledger.salestax, 
				saleledger.remarks,
				saleledger.custrefno, 
				sd.icode,
				sd.saleprice,
				sd.rowgroup, 
				sd.discperc,
				sd.packunits,
				sd.unitsalestax,
				sd.gstperc,

				item.icode,
				item.printable,
